package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

type wire struct {
	Status  int               `json:"statusCode"`
	Headers map[string]string `json:"headers"`
	Body    string            `json:"body"`
	Base64  bool              `json:"isBase64Encoded"`
}
type receipt struct {
	Mode         string
	UID          int
	PID          int
	Cases        []string
	BodySHA256   []string
	NativeJoined bool
	Forced       bool
}

var cases = []string{"page", "layout", "boundary-panic", "global-panic", "local", "missing"}

func check(name string, status int, headers map[string]string, body string) error {
	want := "Global replacement"
	if name == "local" {
		want = "Local replacement"
	}
	if name == "global-panic" {
		want = "Something went wrong"
	}
	if status != 500 || !strings.Contains(body, want) || strings.Contains(body, "private") || strings.Contains(body, "discarded") {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: wrong status/public body", name)
	}
	if (name == "local") != strings.Contains(body, "data-route-layout") {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: route layout ownership", name)
	}
	if name != "local" && name != "global-panic" {
		found := false
		for k, v := range headers {
			if strings.EqualFold(k, "X-Global-Fallback") && v == "yes" {
				found = true
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return errors.New("native global convention header missing")
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func run(binary, mode string) (result receipt, err error) {
	result.Mode = mode
	result.UID = os.Getuid()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	env := []string{"PATH=/usr/bin:/bin", "GOMAXPROCS=2"}
	args := []string{"-env-dir", "/"}
	origin := ""
	reports := make(chan wire, len(cases))
	reportErrors := make(chan error, len(cases)+1)
	var next, posted atomic.Int32
	var runtimeServer *httptest.Server
	if mode == "http" {
		l, e := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
		if e != nil {
			return result, e
		}
		address := l.Addr().String()
		l.Close()
		origin = "http://" + address
		args = append(args, "-addr", address)
	} else {
		runtimeServer = httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/invocation/next") {
				index := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
				if index >= len(cases) {
					<-r.Context().Done()
					return
				}
				name := cases[index]
				w.Header().Set("Lambda-Runtime-Aws-Request-Id", name)
				w.Header().Set("Lambda-Runtime-Deadline-Ms", strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Add(15*time.Second).UnixMilli(), 10))
				path := "/"
				if name == "missing" {
					path = "/unknown"
				}
				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"version": "2.0", "rawPath": path, "rawQueryString": "mode=" + name, "headers": map[string]string{"accept-encoding": "identity"}, "requestContext": map[string]any{"domainName": "example.test", "http": map[string]string{"method": "GET", "path": path, "protocol": "HTTP/1.1", "sourceIp": "127.0.0.1"}}})
				return
			}
			index := int(posted.Add(1)) - 1
			if index >= len(cases) || r.URL.Path != "/2018-06-01/runtime/invocation/"+cases[index]+"/response" {
				reportErrors <- errors.New("unexpected Runtime response route")
				w.WriteHeader(500)
				return
			}
			data, e := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, (64<<10)+1))
			if e != nil || len(data) > 64<<10 {
				reportErrors <- errors.New("bounded Runtime report failed")
				w.WriteHeader(500)
				return
			}
			var response wire
			if mode == "streaming" {
				delimiter := bytes.Index(data, make([]byte, 8))
				if delimiter < 0 {
					reportErrors <- errors.New("stream delimiter missing")
					w.WriteHeader(500)
					return
				}
				e = json.Unmarshal(data[:delimiter], &response)
				response.Body = string(data[delimiter+8:])
				if r.Header.Get("Lambda-Runtime-Function-Response-Mode") != "streaming" {
					e = errors.New("stream report header missing")
				}
			} else {
				e = json.Unmarshal(data, &response)
				if e == nil && response.Base64 {
					var decoded []byte
					decoded, e = base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(response.Body)
					response.Body = string(decoded)
				}
			}
			if e != nil {
				reportErrors <- e
				w.WriteHeader(500)
				return
			}
			reports <- response
			w.WriteHeader(202)
		}))
		defer runtimeServer.Close()
		env = append(env, "AWS_LAMBDA_RUNTIME_API="+strings.TrimPrefix(runtimeServer.URL, "http://"))
		if mode == "streaming" {
			env = append(env, "NEXTGO_LAMBDA_RESPONSE_MODE=streaming")
		}
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(binary, args...)
	cmd.Dir = "/"
	cmd.Env = env
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	var logs bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout = &logs
	cmd.Stderr = &logs
	if e := cmd.Start(); e != nil {
		return result, e
	}
	result.PID = cmd.Process.Pid
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- cmd.Wait() }()
	defer func() {
		cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM)
		select {
		case e := <-done:
			result.NativeJoined = true
			if e != nil && err == nil {
				err = fmt.Errorf("native exit: %w", e)
			}
		case <-time.After(8 * time.Second):
			result.Forced = true
			syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
			<-done
			if err == nil {
				err = errors.New("native graceful join missing")
			}
		}
		if logs.Len() > 64<<10 && err == nil {
			err = errors.New("native log bound exceeded")
		}
	}()
	status, e := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/proc/%d/status", cmd.Process.Pid))
	if e != nil {
		return result, e
	}
	uidLine := ""
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(status), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Uid:") {
			uidLine = line
		}
	}
	values := strings.Fields(uidLine)
	if len(values) != 5 {
		return result, errors.New("native UID observation missing")
	}
	for _, v := range values[1:] {
		if v != strconv.Itoa(result.UID) {
			return result, errors.New("native UID mismatch")
		}
	}
	transport := &http.Transport{DisableKeepAlives: true}
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	client := &http.Client{Transport: transport, Timeout: time.Second}
	if mode == "http" {
		ready := false
		for !ready {
			req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "GET", origin+"/?mode=local", nil)
			r, e := client.Do(req)
			if e == nil {
				io.Copy(io.Discard, r.Body)
				r.Body.Close()
				ready = r.StatusCode == 500
			}
			if !ready {
				select {
				case <-ctx.Done():
					return result, ctx.Err()
				case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, name := range cases {
		var response wire
		if mode == "http" {
			path := "/"
			if name == "missing" {
				path = "/unknown"
			}
			req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "GET", origin+path+"?mode="+name, nil)
			req.Header.Set("Accept-Encoding", "identity")
			r, e := client.Do(req)
			if e != nil {
				return result, e
			}
			data, e := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, (64<<10)+1))
			r.Body.Close()
			if e != nil || len(data) > 64<<10 {
				return result, errors.New("bounded HTTP read failed")
			}
			response.Status = r.StatusCode
			response.Headers = map[string]string{}
			for k := range r.Header {
				response.Headers[k] = r.Header.Get(k)
			}
			response.Body = string(data)
		} else {
			select {
			case response = <-reports:
			case e := <-reportErrors:
				return result, e
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return result, ctx.Err()
			}
		}
		if e := check(name, response.Status, response.Headers, response.Body); e != nil {
			return result, e
		}
		result.Cases = append(result.Cases, name)
		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(response.Body))
		result.BodySHA256 = append(result.BodySHA256, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]))
	}
	return result, nil
}
func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("one immutable native binary required")
	}
	all := []receipt{}
	for _, mode := range []string{"http", "buffered", "streaming"} {
		r, e := run(os.Args[1], mode)
		all = append(all, r)
		if e != nil {
			json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"status": "FAIL", "error": e.Error(), "receipts": all})
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"status": "PASS", "receipts": all})
}
